nights.title: Joy Oladokun
nights.name: Joy Oladokun
nights.extract: Olubukola Joy Oladokun is an American singer-songwriter. Oladokun's music spans the genres of folk, R&B, rock, and pop and is influenced by her identity as a queer person of color. She has released six studio albums: Carry (2016), In Defense of My Own Happiness  (2020), In Defense of My Own Happiness (2021), Proof of Life (2023), Observations from a Crowded Room (2024), and Hope is a Heavy Thing (2026).

nights.title: Rod Wave: Don't Look Down Tour
nights.name: Rod Wave
nights.extract: Rodarius Marcell Green, known professionally as Rod Wave, is an American rapper, singer, and songwriter. Signed to Alamo Records, Green is known for his strong voice and incorporation of hip hop and R&B, having been recognized as a pioneer of "trap-soul." Green rose to prominence with his 2019 single "Heart on Ice," which first went viral on TikTok before peaking at number 25 on the Billboard Hot 100. The song preceded his debut studio album, Ghetto Gospel (2019), which peaked at number ten on the US Billboard 200. His second album, Pray 4 Love (2020), peaked at number two on the chart and included the song "Rags2Riches", which peaked at number 12 on the Billboard Hot 100.

nights.title: Hovvdy
nights.name: Hovvdy
nights.extract: Hovvdy is an American indie pop duo formed in Austin, Texas by Charlie Martin and Will Taylor.
